n_replicates_ok <- tar_read(
        mc_summaries_stats1_10000,
        store = store_in_pipeline()
    ) %>% 
    group_by(model) %>% 
    summarise(R_eff = unique(n_replicates_ok)) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = R_eff)

save_and_output(
    build_supfig_montecarlo_stats1(
        tar_read(
            models_stab_across_habitats,
            store = store_in_pipeline()
        )$models$abs_trend_average,
        tar_read(
            mc_summaries_stats1_10000,
            store = store_in_pipeline()
        )
    ),
filename = here::here("output/Fig_S10.png"),

height =1.118 * 7.5,
unit = "in",

)
